questions.questionText: Explain the concept of inheritance in Object-Oriented Programming. Provide examples and discuss its benefits and potential drawbacks.
questions.modelAnswer: Inheritance is a fundamental OOP concept that allows a class to inherit properties and methods from another class. The class being inherited from is called the parent or base class, while the class that inherits is called the child or derived class. Benefits include code reuse and the ability to create specialized versions of existing classes. Drawbacks can include tight coupling and potential violation of encapsulation.
